authorization: User approved fixed R and DINO, fresh g/head, A-C three conditions, five natural point-count strata, and all-missing presence-only routing

DINO.load_scope_natural_runs: backbone only; build all keypoint head modules from random initialization; never load trained head weights

fixed.module_mode: eval; gradients disabled and buffer hashes unchanged

trainable.head: all non-DINO keypoint components including projections, query embeddings, transformer/refinement, coordinate/presence/visibility heads initialized fresh, same seed and initial state across A/B/C
trainable.g: fresh NaturalFeatureGate(384), channel=1.0; per-patch sigmoid replacement weight, existing normalized X/R + cosine difference + patch-coordinate inputs
trainable.g_parameter_initialization: existing gate defaults, last bias=-2; identical A/B/C

topology: frozen E16 K8192 epoch49 recovery -> R [B,384,16,16]
fresh trainable Query Refinement head -> 5 points, presence and visibility
gate_meaning: task-optimal feature adoption, not a calibrated physical occlusion probability

supervision.g_loss: final head position error only, valid annotated coordinates v>0; no loss on absent coordinates
supervision.head_loss: existing Query Refinement coordinate/presence/visibility and existing auxiliary heads, with their current weights; no new heatmap head
supervision.gradient_routing: g gradients computed only from L_position; head gradients from L_head_total. Presence/visibility/auxiliary losses must not update g. Frozen R/DINO receive no gradients or EMA updates. All-missing batches skip g optimizer entirely.
supervision.all_missing: 1844 train faces remain in head presence training only; no fabricated coordinate or pseudo-label loss for g
supervision.coordinate_policy: visible v=2 and annotated occluded v=1 included; missing v=0 excluded

data.crop: GT ellipse aligned square x1.25, 256x256, same frozen DINO normalization
data.source_video_overlap: keep official video-separated splits; donor only from same training split and different video
data.angle_policy: as user requested, do not separate pose/self-occlusion from external occlusion in this experiment

sampling.natural_proxy: count of original annotated slots with state 0 or 1; not measured area
sampling.balance: same draw count for each of five position-supervised natural groups; cycle minority groups without dropping majority or any original train face
sampling.mixed_balance: natural half balanced by point-count proxy; augmented half balanced by ACTUAL added occlusion area within recipient ellipse. Two different severity measures, reported separately; no claim of measured natural area or uniform physical area for the combined pool.
joint_distribution_audit: actual synthetic area x resulting nonvisible point count
excluded g-position targets and head-only faces
sampling.all_train_usage: every original recipient face appears; balancing uses repeated minor groups rather than downsampling away training faces

augmentation_common.policy: same non-occlusion baseline transformations and seeds across A/B/C; disable both baseline occlusion switches in A; in B/C replace the baseline 10-40%/probability settings with the stated mixed-source and five-area-bin schedule
augmentation_common.visibility_update: retain recipient GT coordinates; newly hidden labeled points become v=1, existing v=1 stays occluded, original missing v=0 remains missing; do not train on donor landmark identities
augmentation_common.synthetic_features: recompute frozen DINO and R from changed RGB; never reuse unoccluded features for altered images

cannot_reuse_for: geometric or photometric augmentation that changes pixels
features restored by an older recovery model
cache.storage_policy: bounded active-generation cache; no unbounded per-epoch feature archives; no writes to paused-run caches

optimization_proposal.validation_selection: minimum equal-stratum natural-validation annotated-point position error; also report all-face micro average and occluded/visible separately
optimization_proposal.early_stop: minimum10 complete balanced passes; 5 validation checks without significant position improvement; maximum40 passes; no forced LR-floor wait
optimization_proposal.budget_accounting: A and B/C must be compared at common optimizer step counts and equal draws per shared severity/source contract; report unique faces and repeat counts, not nominal epochs alone
optimization_proposal.status: provisional implementation defaults, not user-confirmed or executed

evaluation: natural full official val/test, five point-count strata
visible versus annotated-occluded point errors; missing presence performance separately
same artificial five-area-bin official test for comparison with current E16
high-occlusion 60-100% combined, large-error rate, small-face breakdown
g distributions, all-zero/all-one collapse diagnostics; do not use segmentation accuracy as g objective
gate_checks: fresh head differs from trained baseline and identical across A/B/C
fixed DINO/R parameters and buffers including codebook EMA unchanged
all-missing rows give no g position update
all original train faces covered; natural and synthetic strata each balanced as specified
no donor video or train/val/test leakage; no expanded donor ellipse
cache identities match actual transformed RGB and fixed model hashes
failure_policy: stop; no automatic quality retry or threshold relaxation
implementation_status: new g/head trainer, samplers and augmentation interfaces must be implemented before gate
